description: Delete one person's data that their stored ids or email link to: their feedback, saved error examples, support conversations, usage profiles, linked browser ids, visits and events. Pass exactly one of user, anonymousId or email. An email finds the notes with that address. It follows a user or browser id to other notes and error examples only when the id comes from a usage profile with that email or from a note your server or a signed-in browser sent with it. An address someone typed on a note never leads to other notes or conversations. Errors a server sends carry only user, so call again with user and with each anonymousId you know, one id per call. A browser id never brings a note or visit another signed-in user made from the same browser. A browser id linked to a matched usage profile also brings that browser's notes and error examples sent without a user id. One found only on a note covers its anonymous visits and events, never the account it is linked to. Conversations without a stored link to that person can't be found. Returns deleted-record counts, not proof every identity was found. A company record another user still names stays. Daily totals, which name nobody, stay; the recent ones are recalculated without this person in the nightly rollup (rollupsPending says one is waiting). Delayed feedback and contact writes using erased identities are blocked for 30 days, and delayed usage writes for 2 days. A person is refused when they have more than 50,000 visits plus events or 2,000 notes, and nothing is erased: featury support can erase them. This can't be undone. Each call is audited. You can make 100 export or erase calls a day in total (UTC), across the app, the API and AI apps. MANAGER+ required.

anonymousId.description: The anonymous id (a UUID) the person's browser or app sent

email.description: The person's email: the one they left to hear back, or the one their profile was signed with. It also reaches the other notes and error examples of a user or browser id, but only one that comes from a usage profile with this email or from a note your server or a signed-in browser sent with it. Send user in a separate call to reach the rest

user.description: Your app's own user id, exactly as your server sent it with feedback or signed it for the browser

name: erase_person
title: Erase one person's data
